title: The chunk table of a dlv:hilbert layout is in ascending Hilbert index
description: The Hilbert index of each chunk (y, x) is computed by Skilling's algorithm with two bits per dimension, y the first axis; keys of a chunk index 3 take no entry. The table lists the chunks in that order, and the cells, read through it, are 0 to 17 in order. (A processor that orders the table by the Morton key, or by rows, reads other chunks.)
